reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "A. (Preferred) Enable the WAL and rely on the new ingester to replay the WAL", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Operators upgrading to 3.0.0 must enable WAL replay to replace the removed max_transfer_retries mechanism; optionally enable flush_on_shutdown to flush ingester data to long-term storage on shutdowns.

proposed.statement: Loki 3.0.0 recommends enabling WAL and optionally enabling flush_on_shutdown to handle the removal of max_transfer_retries configuration.
